scenario: A veterinary clinic will see exactly six patients—Groucho, Hazel, Juniper, Kobe, Luna, and Moss—one at a time, in six consecutive appointment slots numbered 1 through 6. Each appointment is handled by exactly one of two veterinarians: Dr. Park handles the appointments in slots 1, 2, and 3, and Dr. Quinn handles the appointments in slots 4, 5, and 6. The following conditions apply: Groucho's appointment is earlier than Hazel's. Juniper is seen in slot 2. Moss is seen by Dr. Quinn. Kobe is seen immediately before Luna.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be the order in which the patients are seen, from slot 1 through slot 6?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Groucho, Juniper, Hazel, Kobe, Luna, Moss

choices.label: B
choices.text: Groucho, Juniper, Moss, Kobe, Luna, Hazel

choices.label: C
choices.text: Moss, Juniper, Groucho, Kobe, Luna, Hazel

choices.label: D
choices.text: Groucho, Hazel, Juniper, Kobe, Luna, Moss

choices.label: E
choices.text: Groucho, Juniper, Hazel, Luna, Kobe, Moss

explanations.correct: Groucho(1) before Hazel(3) ✓; Juniper at 2 ✓; Moss at 6 (handled by Dr. Quinn) ✓; Kobe(4) immediately before Luna(5) ✓.
explanations.B: Moss is in slot 3, which is handled by Dr. Park. Moss must be seen by Dr. Quinn.
explanations.C: Moss is in slot 1, handled by Dr. Park. Moss must be seen by Dr. Quinn.
explanations.D: Juniper is in slot 3, but Juniper must be in slot 2.
explanations.E: Kobe must be immediately before Luna, not after.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Juniper is seen by Dr. Park.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Hazel is seen by Dr. Quinn.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Kobe is seen by Dr. Quinn.

explanations.correct: Juniper is fixed at slot 2, and slots 1–3 are handled by Dr. Park. Therefore Juniper must be seen by Dr. Park.
explanations.A: Correct — Juniper at slot 2 falls within Dr. Park's block.
explanations.B: Hazel could be in slot 3 (Dr. Park) in some valid arrangements.
explanations.C: Kobe could be in slot 3 (Dr. Park) in some valid arrangements.
explanations.D: Groucho could be in slot 3 with Moss in slot 1... no, Moss can't be in slot 1, but Groucho could still be in slot 3.
explanations.E: Luna could be in slot 4 or 6 in various arrangements.

questions.questionStem: If Hazel is seen in slot 3, then which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: If Hazel is in slot 3, Groucho must be in slot 1 (earlier than Hazel; slot 2 is Juniper). Kobe–Luna as a consecutive pair fit in slots 4–5 or 5–6. With Kobe(5)–Luna(6), Moss takes slot 4.
explanations.A: Hazel is in slot 3, so Groucho cannot also be in slot 3.
explanations.B: Correct — with Groucho(1), Juniper(2), Hazel(3), Moss(4), Kobe(5), Luna(6), all rules hold.
explanations.C: Kobe must be immediately before Luna, so Kobe cannot be in slot 6.
explanations.D: If Luna is in slot 4, Kobe is in slot 3, but Hazel is in slot 3.
explanations.E: Juniper is in slot 2, so Moss cannot be.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following CANNOT be true?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Hazel is seen by Dr. Park.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Luna is seen by Dr. Park.

explanations.correct: Luna must come immediately after Kobe. The earliest Luna can be is slot 3 (with Kobe in slot 2) — but slot 2 is Juniper. So Luna must be in slot 4, 5, or 6, all of which are Dr. Quinn's slots.
explanations.A: Groucho could be in slot 3 (e.g., with Moss in 1 and Hazel in 4).
explanations.B: Hazel could be in slot 3 (Dr. Park's block).
explanations.C: Correct — Luna cannot occupy any of slots 1–3, so Luna is never seen by Dr. Park.
explanations.D: Kobe could be in slot 3 with Luna in slot 4.
explanations.E: Moss could be in slot 4 (e.g., with Kobe in 5 and Luna in 6).

questions.questionStem: If Kobe is seen in slot 3, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: If Kobe is in slot 3, then Luna (immediately after Kobe) is in slot 4.
explanations.A: Moss could be in slot 5 or 6.
explanations.B: Correct — Luna must be in slot 4 whenever Kobe is in slot 3.
explanations.C: Hazel could be in slot 5 or 6.
explanations.D: Juniper is in slot 2, so Groucho cannot be.
explanations.E: Moss could be in slot 5 or 6.
